title: Caymus Friendsgiving
seo_title: Caymus Friendsgiving Wine Dinner in Ozark, MO
description: Caymus Friendsgiving is a Thanksgiving-style wine dinner where a prepared meal is paired with Caymus wines, with no shopping, cooking, or cleanup for guests. Happy hour begins at 6 PM and dinner at 7 PM, and reservations are required. It takes place Thursday, November 19, 2026 at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO.
